inheritance.immutable_records: Historical results, accepted artifacts and frozen protocol identities retain their change controls.
inheritance.implementation_and_evidence: unchanged; verify predecessor bindings and live state
inheritance.new_authority: No acceptance, deployment, physical-control or outbound-message authority created.
inheritance.prior_handbook_prescriptions: The proposed first binding task is a recommendation, not a restriction on independent thought or a justified better route.

method_selection.state_of_the_art_claim_requires: dated relevant comparison establishing the claimed advantage
method_selection.stop_research_when: Remaining uncertainty requires computation, an observation or an external workflow test rather than another broad source collection.
method_selection.trigger: A technical uncertainty can materially alter correctness, usefulness or cost.

mission.broader_hypothesis: evidence for the marginal contribution of additional observers/components; transfer requires domain-specific semantics and evidence
mission.present_decision: whether a fixed additional detector merits further integration under explicit reference uncertainty and declared loss

operator_priorities.ambition: original, consequential scientific and engineering advances with value to autonomous and AI system builders
operator_priorities.benchmark_discipline: serious baselines, explicit population, held-out evaluation where appropriate, freeze before outcomes, retained negative results
operator_priorities.institutional_attention: not technical validation or a valuation estimate
operator_priorities.public_voice: precise, direct, humble, dignified; result and evidence before superlatives; partial answers described as partial
operator_priorities.research_habit: relevant primary-source review at material choices, failures and milestones; inspect arXiv versions and primary papers; turn learning into a check or implementation decision

private_packet_locator: Operator Reiyah Research START_HERE index; full successor prompt and original exact-input handoff retained locally.

recommended_first_task.may_replace_with: a justified stronger authorized task, with a retained decision record before dependent execution
recommended_first_task.why: Prevent valid but wrong-population or substituted-asset evidence from constraining a detector comparison.

revision_scope: Successor instructions and method-selection standard only; no Engine code, empirical result or protocol execution change.
source_of_live_state: Git, retained exact inputs/results and current operator instructions; reconcile changes before work.
